title: Psychophysics
description: How bright a light seems grows not with its intensity but with the logarithm of it (Weber and Fechner): S = k·ln(I/I₀). Whether you notice a faint signal at all depends on how far it stands out of the noise (d′) and on where you set your threshold: low, and you see things that are not there; high, and you miss things that are. Unlocks the Psychophysics Booth, the Rhodopsin Retina and the Low-Light Visor.

puzzle.goal: A light of intensity I against a threshold intensity I₀. Fechner: equal ratios of intensity feel like equal steps. Write the sensation S, with a constant k.
puzzle.name: The Weber–Fechner law
puzzle.ask: Find S for k = @{k}, I = @{I} and I₀ = @{I0} (in the same units).
puzzle.method: Weber: the just-noticeable step dI is a fixed fraction of I. Add up dS = k·dI/I from I₀ to I.
